dmz.quest.void_training_1.name: Stillness in the Void
dmz.quest.void_training_1.desc: Defeat 15 Raditz-class enemies without the benefit of Ki Control.
dmz.quest.void_training_2.name: Pressure Without Power
dmz.quest.void_training_2.desc: Defeat 18 Vegeta-class enemies in the second trial.
dmz.quest.void_training_3.name: The Unbroken Will
dmz.quest.void_training_3.desc: Defeat Frieza, whose strength dwarfs the previous trials.
dmz.quest.void_training_4.name: At the Edge of the Horizon
dmz.quest.void_training_4.desc: Defeat 28 Cell-class enemies in a test of endurance.
dmz.quest.void_training_5.name: The Void Master
dmz.quest.void_training_5.desc: Defeat 32 Buu-class enemies, then defeat the final Buu. The reward grants Ki Control.
dmz.quest.void_ascension_1.name: Trial of the Abyss
dmz.quest.void_ascension_1.desc: Defeat five Raditz-class enemies and then defeat the Raditz trial boss.
dmz.quest.void_ascension_2.name: Trial of the Ascendant
dmz.quest.void_ascension_2.desc: Defeat 18 Vegeta-class enemies and then defeat the Vegeta trial boss.
dmz.quest.void_ascension_3.name: Trial of Event Horizon
dmz.quest.void_ascension_3.desc: Defeat 28 Frieza-class enemies and then defeat the Frieza trial boss.
dmz.quest.void_ascension_4.name: Trial of Eternal Void
dmz.quest.void_ascension_4.desc: Defeat 32 Cell-class enemies and then defeat the Cell trial boss.
dmz.quest.void_ascension_5.name: Trial of the Voidstone Abyss
dmz.quest.void_ascension_5.desc: Defeat 40 Buu-class enemies and then defeat the final Buu.
dmz_voidstone.story.ki_control_locked: Tsukisora must complete the Void Training saga before receiving Ki Control.
